slides.headline: Hocus Pocus at Factory Town, Oct. 30 to Nov. 1
slides.body: Starts 7 p.m. Friday, Oct. 30, at Factory Town in Miami. Tickets cost $120 to $250. Chase & Status, Eric Prydz, Gorgon City, Indira Paganotto, Meduza, and Nora En Pure are on the bill.

slides.headline: DC Pie and Dom’s Halloween party, Oct. 31
slides.body: Starts at 5 p.m. Friday, Oct. 31, at DC Pie Co. and Dom's, 1010 Brickell Ave. in Miami. Kids 12 and under in costume get a free personal pizza with purchase at DC Pie Co., and Dom's runs a costume contest and tequila specials.

slides.headline: Lincoln Road Halloween Block Party, Oct. 31
slides.body: Starts at 5 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 31, on Lincoln Road in Miami Beach. Admission is free. Kids trick-or-treat from 5:30 to 7:30 p.m., then the adult party starts at 8 p.m.

slides.headline: Mushroom Jazz at ZeyZey, Oct. 31
slides.body: Starts 7 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 31, at ZeyZey in Miami. Admission is free with RSVP before 11 p.m., then tickets cost $24 to $64. Mark Farina's series brings instrumental hip-hop and downtempo sets.

slides.body: Starts 8 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 31, at Miramar Amphitheater in Miramar. Tickets cost $54 to $128. BigXthaPlug, Sexyy Red, and Rob49 are scheduled to perform.
